inputs.name: filepath
inputs.purpose: Absolute or relative path to the binary radar data file (.raw) to read.

outputs.name: Header
outputs.purpose: RadarData array (1 × beam_count). Each element holds the 1024-byte header fields and a 3-D BeamData array (RangeBins × NFFT × InCohIntegrations) of complex IQ samples.

outputs.name: structure
outputs.purpose: Scalar struct with fields vertical, north, west, south, east. Each field holds a RadarData element augmented with direction, denoised_spectra, spectra, and noise_level fields.

inputs.name: raw_data_matrix
inputs.purpose: 3-D complex array (RangeBins × NFFT × InCohIntegrations) of raw IQ samples, as stored in Header(i).BeamData by read_raw_file.

outputs.name: denoised_spectra
outputs.purpose: 2-D real array (RangeBins × NFFT). Normalised power spectrum with estimated noise floor subtracted (negative values clamped to zero).

outputs.name: spectra
outputs.purpose: 2-D real array (RangeBins × NFFT). Incoherently averaged, normalised power spectrum before noise subtraction.

outputs.name: noise_level
outputs.purpose: Column vector (RangeBins × 1). Per-range-bin noise floor estimate produced by HS_noise_estimate.

inputs.name: spectrums
inputs.purpose: 2-D real power spectrum array (RangeBins × NFFT). Each row is the Doppler spectrum for one height bin, as returned by compute_simple_spectra.

inputs.name: M
inputs.purpose: Scalar. Number of incoherent integrations used when acquiring the spectrum; scales the Hildebrand–Sekhon R_n statistic.

outputs.name: noise_level
outputs.purpose: Column vector (RangeBins × 1). Estimated mean noise power per Doppler bin for each range bin.

inputs.name: denoised_spectrum
inputs.purpose: 2-D real array (RangeBins × NFFT). Noise-subtracted, normalised power spectrum, as returned in the first output of compute_simple_spectra.

inputs.name: ipp_us
inputs.purpose: Scalar. Inter-Pulse Period in microseconds (Header(i).m_fIntrPulsePeriod_us). Used to derive the effective sampling time and Doppler frequency spacing.

inputs.name: n_coh
inputs.purpose: Scalar. Number of coherent integrations (Header(i).m_sNumOfCohIntegrations). Multiplied with ipp_us to obtain the effective sampling time T_eff.

outputs.name: M0
outputs.purpose: Column vector (RangeBins × 1). Zeroth moment — total signal power per height bin (integral of the spectrum).

outputs.name: M1
outputs.purpose: Column vector (RangeBins × 1). First moment — mean Doppler frequency (Hz) per height bin.

outputs.name: M2
outputs.purpose: Column vector (RangeBins × 1). Second moment — Doppler spectral width (variance in Hz²) per height bin.

inputs.name: azimuth
inputs.purpose: Scalar. Beam azimuth angle in degrees (Header(i).m_fAzimuth). 0 = north, 90 = west, 180 = south, 270 = east.

inputs.name: offZenith
inputs.purpose: Scalar. Off-zenith angle in degrees (Header(i).m_fOffZenith). 0 indicates a vertically pointing beam.

inputs.name: beams
inputs.purpose: Struct array of beam elements (e.g., from add_reference_data). Each element must contain BeamData, m_fIntrPulsePeriod_us, m_sNumOfCohIntegrations, m_fWindow1StartHeight, m_fWindow1EndHeight, and direction fields.

inputs.name: path
inputs.purpose: Base filename (without the '+.mmts' suffix) of the moments file inside Data/Mode_<mode_>/.

inputs.name: mode_
inputs.purpose: Radar operation mode index used to select the subdirectory Data/Mode_<mode_>/. Defaults to 1.

outputs.name: output
outputs.purpose: MATLAB table read from the .mmts text file, with original column names preserved. Columns correspond to M0, M1, M2, SNR, and noise level per range bin.

inputs.name: in_mmts
inputs.purpose: Reference moments matrix loaded from a .mmts file (via read_mmts). Columns: [M0 (dBm), M1 (Hz), M2 (Hz), SNR (dB), Noise Level (dBm)].

inputs.name: computed_mmts
inputs.purpose: Computed moments matrix in the same column layout as in_mmts, derived from compute_moments and the noise estimates.
